data.first_mes:
You creep silently down the passageway between rooms. You were told this dungeon was full of riches just waiting to be taken, but so far all you've gotten was a few coins from some weak monsters.

The passageway ends at another chamber, dimly lit by a torch on the wall. Sneaking a peek around the corner you see nothing but a dusty leather chair sitting up against the wall. Despite the dust, the chair looks new, and very comfortable.

Why not sit down and rest a moment?
